mcqs.question: Since which year has National Pharmacy Education Day been observed by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)?
mcqs.explanation: National Pharmacy Education Day has been observed by the Pharmacy Council of India since 2023. The tempting option 2022 is incorrect; the stated year is 2023.

mcqs.question: Jan Aushadhi Day 2026 marked which edition and the conclusion of which observance?
options: The 6th Jan Aushadhi Day and the end of Jan Aushadhi Fortnight
The 7th Jan Aushadhi Day and the end of Jan Aushadhi Week
The 8th Jan Aushadhi Day and the end of Jan Aushadhi Week
The 8th Jan Aushadhi Day and the end of National Safety Week
mcqs.explanation: Jan Aushadhi Day 2026 was the 8th Jan Aushadhi Day and marked the end of Jan Aushadhi Week held from March 1 to March 7. National Safety Week is not the observance referred to here.

mcqs.question: Who was the Director General of the CISF on CISF Foundation Day 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Praveer Ranjan was the Director General of the CISF. Sarbananda Sonowal, Ashish Shelar and Jitendra Singh are associated with other events in the current-affairs list.

mcqs.question:
Match the following with the correct details relating to the Port of Refuge and the largest floating solar project in India.

List-I
 a. APSEZ
 b. Dighi and Gopalpur
 c. Onkareshwar
 d. 278 MW

List-II
 i. Capacity of the floating solar project
 ii. Locations of the western and eastern Ports of Refuge
 iii. Developer of the Ports of Refuge project
 iv. Location of the floating solar project

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are APSEZ–developer of the Ports of Refuge project, Dighi and Gopalpur–western and eastern locations, Onkareshwar–location of the floating solar project, and 278 MW–its capacity. The other codes interchange these project details.

mcqs.question: Which organisation achieved the first production of 50 MT of iron ore in India during FY 2025–26?
mcqs.explanation: NMDC achieved the first 50 MT iron-ore production milestone in India during FY 2025–26. APSEZ, SCI and Micron are linked to other firsts, not this iron-ore milestone.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: The 2026 World Water Day theme was “Water and Gender”.
Statement B: Its slogan was “Where Water Flows, Equality Falls”.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is true: the theme was “Water and Gender”. Statement B is false because the slogan was “Where Water Flows, Equality Grows”, not “Equality Falls”.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements about Shaheed Diwas and World TB Day in 2026 are correct?

1. Bhagat Singh, Rajguru and Sukhdev were hanged in Lahore in 1931.
2. The theme of World TB Day was “Yes! We Can End TB”.
3. The three revolutionaries were hanged in Delhi in 1931.
mcqs.explanation: Only one statement is correct: the World TB Day theme was “Yes! We Can End TB”. Statement 3 is the tempting trap because the hanging took place in Lahore, not Delhi; statement 1 is also incorrect as written because it combines the Shaheed Diwas detail with the altered place.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements about major firsts reported in India:

1. “Agnite” was described as the world's first fully 3D-printed booster engine.
2. Agnikul Cosmos developed “Agnite” in 2017 at IIT Madras Research Park, and it was tested at ALP-01 in Chennai.
3. The hydrogen-powered train trial by RDSO covered 20 km at a maximum speed of 70 km/h between Jind and Sonipat, and the train was built by ICF Chennai.
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. “Agnite” was Agnikul Cosmos’s fully 3D-printed booster engine, while the RDSO hydrogen-train trial covered 20 km at up to 70 km/h on the Jind–Sonipat route.

mcqs.question: Which city became associated with India's first full ring metro network in March 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Delhi was associated with India's first full ring metro network, with two lines inaugurated on March 8, 2026. Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata are not the city identified for this first.

mcqs.question:
Match the following with the correct details concerning India's first Port of Refuge and largest floating solar project.

List-I
 a. Port of Refuge
 b. Dighi
 c. Onkareshwar
 d. Rewa Ultra Mega Solar

List-II
 i. Western location of a Port of Refuge
 ii. Floating solar project on the Narmada in Khandwa
 iii. Developer associated with the 278 MW floating solar project
 iv. Project involving Dighi and Gopalpur

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Port of Refuge–the Dighi and Gopalpur project, Dighi–the western location, Onkareshwar–the floating solar project on the Narmada in Khandwa, and Rewa Ultra Mega Solar–the associated project. The other codes misplace the locations and project associations.

mcqs.question: Which organisation was identified with India's first 50 MT iron-ore milestone and has its headquarters in Hyderabad?
mcqs.explanation: NMDC was identified with the first 50 MT iron-ore milestone and has its headquarters in Hyderabad. Deloitte India, BPCL and SCI are linked to cybersecurity, LPG vending and shipping firsts respectively.

mcqs.question:
Match the following firsts with the organisations associated with them.

List-I
 a. ConnectSafe
 b. LPG ATM
 c. Cybersecurity facility
 d. AI vending machine

List-II
 i. BPCL
 ii. Deloitte India
 iii. ConnectSafe
 iv. LPG cylinder dispensing in 2–3 minutes

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: ConnectSafe was the cybersecurity facility of Deloitte India, while the LPG ATM was an AI vending machine by BPCL that dispensed a cylinder in 2–3 minutes. Thus a-ii, b-i, c-ii and d-iv is the correct code.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:
Statement A: SCI, with Mazagon Dock, developed the 3,000 DWT methanol dual-fuel PSV.
Statement B: AVATAAR was an amphibious transport drone developed by AquaAirX Autonomous Systems.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is true: SCI and Mazagon Dock developed the 3,000 DWT methanol dual-fuel PSV. Statement B is false because AVATAAR was an amphibious surveillance drone, not an amphibious transport drone.

mcqs.question:
Match the following firsts and entities with the correct descriptions.

List-I
 a. Japan
 b. AMCHEPRI
 c. Slovenia
 d. ReHeart

List-II
 i. Cardiac patch by Cureips
 ii. First EU country to ration energy
 iii. Stem-cell therapy for Parkinson's
 iv. Stem-cell therapy approved by Japan

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: Japan was the first country to approve stem-cell therapy for Parkinson's, AMCHEPRI was the therapy, Slovenia was the first EU country to ration energy, and ReHeart was the cardiac patch by Cureips. These correspond to a-iv, b-iii, c-ii and d-i.

mcqs.question:
Match the following with the correct details.

List-I
 a. Haldia Bulk Terminal
 b. 4 MMTPA
 c. Micron, Sanand
 d. Class 1000 cleanroom

List-II
 i. Advanced memory ATMP centre
 ii. Capacity of the automated dry bulk terminal
 iii. Automated dry bulk terminal at Hooghly
 iv. Approximate cleanroom area specification

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: Haldia Bulk Terminal was the automated dry bulk terminal at Hooghly, 4 MMTPA was its capacity, Micron at Sanand was the advanced memory ATMP centre, and the centre included a Class 1000 cleanroom. Therefore, a-iii, b-ii, c-i and d-iv is correct.
